episodeTitle.en: Inside Google's AI turnaround: AI Mode, AI Overviews, and vision for AI-powered search | Robby Stein
episodeTitle.zh: 谷歌AI转型内幕：AI模式、AI概览及AI驱动搜索愿景 | 罗比·斯坦

guestBioOfficial.en: Robby Stein is VP of Product at Google, where he oversees the core products of Google Search—including the new AI Overviews, AI Mode, search ranking, Google Lens, and more. Previously, he led consumer products at Instagram, where he and his teams built Stories, Reels, Close Friends, and other key features now used by billions. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 罗比·斯坦是谷歌的产品副总裁，负责谷歌搜索的核心产品，包括新推出的AI概览、AI模式、搜索排名、谷歌Lens等。此前，他曾在Instagram领导消费者产品团队，带领团队开发了如今被数十亿用户使用的故事、短视频、亲密好友等核心功能。*您将学到：*

title.en: Inside Google's AI turnaround: AI Mode, AI Overviews, and vision for AI-powered search | Robby Stein
title.zh: 谷歌AI转型内幕：AI模式、AI概览及AI驱动搜索愿景 | 罗比·斯坦

summary.en: Robby explains why search isn't dying but expanding with AI, and breaks down Google's three-pronged approach: AI Overviews, the new AI Mode, and multimodal experiences like Lens. He describes the renewed focus and urgency inside Google behind Gemini's rise, and why the vast, everyday breadth of search queries is underappreciated by skeptics. The episode offers a front-row view of one of the biggest shifts in Google's history.
summary.zh: Robby 解释了为什么搜索不会消亡，反而正随 AI 扩张，并拆解了 Google 的三叉策略：AI Overviews、全新的 AI Mode，以及以 Lens 为代表的多模态体验。他描述了 Gemini 崛起背后 Google 内部焕然一新的专注与紧迫感，以及为何怀疑者低估了搜索查询在日常上的海量广度。本期提供了 Google 史上最大变革之一的前排视角。
